This is a tricky question because it asks what we *know* will happen in the next twenty years based solely on the fact that gold has gone up in value over the last twenty years. Past performance does not guarantee future results, and there is no certainty about what will happen to gold's value in the future. The only thing we can say with certainty is that we do not know what will happen; gold could rise, fall, or stay the same.

The best answer is the one that reflects this uncertainty.

Answer: H
